Pump draw: about 4 A idle and under 40 A at full load on a stock pump (honda-tech 'EHPS Redone' write-up; diyelectriccar MR2 EHPS wiki), 70-80 A at maximum load on raised-pressure pumps (Alaria Tech FAQ); factory MR-S EHPS fuse 50 A (2002 MR2 EWD element list).
